title: The Border of Vienna
author: Felix Montrose
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
